president.name: Rtn. PHF G M Ravi
president.message: Welcome to Rotary Bangalore JP Nagar. For over 37 years, our club has stood as a beacon of community service, fellowship, and vocational integrity across Bengaluru. In Rotary Year 2026-27, guided by the Rotary International Presidential Message of 'Create Lasting Impact', we recommit ourselves to sustainable health initiatives, quality education in government schools, environmental conservation, and nurturing young leaders through Rotaract and Interact.
president.quote: Real impact happens when dedicated professionals unite to solve real-world community challenges with compassion and accountability.

servicePillars.title: Healthcare & Preventive Care
servicePillars.description: Equipping dialysis centers, organizing medical & blood donation camps, Thalassemia support, and championing the global eradication of Polio.

servicePillars.title: Basic Education & Literacy
servicePillars.description: Happy School transformations, RO drinking water plants, scholarships, science labs, and uniform/book distribution for underprivileged students.

servicePillars.title: Community Economic Development
servicePillars.description: Vocational excellence recognitions, sustainable livelihood programs, women empowerment, and disaster relief aid.

servicePillars.title: Youth Leadership & New Generations
servicePillars.description: Fostering leadership through Rotary Youth Leadership Awards (RYLA) and sponsoring dynamic Rotaract and Interact clubs in Bengaluru.

impactHighlights.label: Annual Community Projects
impactHighlights.description: Health, educational infrastructure, literacy, and vocational awards

impactHighlights.label: Volunteer-Driven Execution
impactHighlights.description: 100% of project contributions go directly to beneficiary initiatives

impactHighlights.label: Rotary District Affiliation
impactHighlights.description: Active participant in District 3191's flagship service programs
